name: Stalwart
description: All-in-one mail server with SMTP, IMAP, JMAP and a web admin.
note: Publishes mail ports 25, 465, 587, 143, 993, 110, 995 and 4190 on the server; free them first. Open /admin on the domain and log in as admin with the admin password shown here. In the setup, keep an HTTP listener on port 8080: the domain points there. Many hosts block port 25.
